nodes.name: Record task follow-up

required: existing authorized task id and current revision
linked decision/source revisions when the follow-up relies on them
development-preparer actor for isolated software acceptance
context.missing_or_stale: Do not dispatch; retain draft and offer authorized task reload/parent recovery.

inputs: follow-up text and explicit next action
existing task and applicable decision/source revision references
command identity for replay-safe record creation
contract.effect: Persist a follow-up management record linked to the current task and return its checked receipt; append the corresponding task audit timeline event. This records the next step, it does not execute it.
contract.success: Show the persisted follow-up id, actor, timestamp and linked revisions within the same task detail and its embedded audit timeline.
contract.cancel: Keep the prior task/decision unchanged; discard or preserve the safe local draft only through an explicit control.
contract.failure: Preserve draft; distinguish forbidden, conflict, stale and unreadable/unknown write receipt. Never show recorded until the authoritative receipt/readback confirms it; retry observes the same command identity.
contract.permission: Require task-record edit scope and audit attribution. CEO decision linkage cannot grant execution, company activation or tools/data access. Inactive company identities remain blocked.

contract.effect: Change display language and direction in the existing shell/component: EN LTR or AR RTL. Do not navigate to a new page or dispatch business work.

contract.failure: Retain the previous working locale and draft; show localized retry guidance without claiming the preference was saved.
contract.permission: UI locale is separate from company activation, skill assignment and tool/data permission.

out_of_scope_controls: Other MVP/later features are roadmap text, not clickable controls. No inherited generic profile/settings/calendar/widget/report navigation.
dynamic_context: All dynamic routes receive a persisted, authorized id. Missing/stale context has no action dispatch and exposes parent/retry recovery.
embedded_audit: Task and decision timelines plus read-only audit-event overlay; no separate audit screen in first preview.
acceptance_identity: Isolated software fixtures use development-preparer actor; proposed owner Nora/etc remains inactive. No claim that a company employee operated or business access was granted.
execution_boundary: Create/inspect management records and CEO decisions under scoped software authorization; autonomous task execution remains blocked until separate activation and permission approval.
no_render: No HQ screen or runtime was generated.
